note: Sound data of bank 5 (header, sound table, waves, PCM table, envelopes, sequences) and the small BPE pointer / palette tables of banks 0, 1 and F. Committed metadata only (offsets, sizes, codecs, evidence) - no game data. Format: docs/formats/sound.md.

structures.name: world_picture_ptrs
structures.evidence: load_world_picture (4000:1D3E mov bp,[word es:bx+0x0], ES=2000h with port C2h=F0h = ROM bank 0, index world-1) passes the word to bpe_expand; the 6 words are the 6 gallery_picture BPE streams of bank 0; the table ends at the first stream (0000C). Runtime: 12 of 12 bytes read.

structures.name: world_bg_palettes
structures.evidence: load_world_picture (4000:1D58 mov si,[es:bx+0x5a48], index = world 0-7 masked to 3 bits; 1D5D-1D79 reads words +2..+0Ah and writes them to BG palette ports 22h-2Ah) with ROM bank 0 at 2000h. 7 index words (first points 0Eh past the table start), 6 records of 16 bytes ending at the FFh padding (05AB6). Words +0, +0Ch, +0Eh of each record are not loaded by the code (palettes 0, 6, 7). Runtime: 72 of 110 bytes read.

structures.name: pause_window_ptrs
structures.evidence: pause_load_window_gfx (4000:10D1 mov bp,[word es:bx+0x0], bx = 0 vertical / 2 horizontal, ROM bank 1 via port C2h=F1h) -> bpe_expand; values = pause_window BPE streams 103E9 and 10004; the table ends at the first stream. Runtime: 4 of 4 bytes read.

structures.name: hint_sign_ptrs
structures.evidence: pause_load_window_gfx (4000:10C4 mov bp,[es:bx+0x829], bx = 2*([13FDh]+1) for hint signs, 0/2 for the 5-item window; bank 1) -> bpe_expand. 34 words: 2 pause_window streams + the 32 hint_sign streams 12BF6-1C056; ends where the menu-label table at 2000:086D begins. Runtime: 10 of 68 bytes read.

structures.name: menu_label_ptrs
structures.evidence: pause_load_item_label (4000:1123 mov bp,[es:di+0x86d], di = 2*item + 0Ah in vertical mode; bank 1) -> bpe_expand. 10 words = the 10 menu_label streams (5 horizontal, 5 vertical); ends at the first stream (10881). Runtime: 12 of 20 bytes read.

structures.name: keyconfig_panel_ptrs
structures.evidence: keyconfig_load_panels (4000:0DE6/0DF4/0E05/0E13 mov bp,[es:bx+0x1399/0x13A5/0x13A1/0x139D], bx = 0 horizontal / 2 vertical; bank 1) -> bpe_expand into tile RAM 34C0h/3A10h; values = keyconfig_panel and yes_no_button streams; ends at the first stream (113A9). structures.name: sound_table
structures.evidence: Header words 5000:0000-0007 read by sound_init (4000:DD78 mov si,[0x0], wave copy), snd_channel_pitch_volume (4000:E511 add ax,[0x0]; E4BE mov di,[0x6]), snd_track_output_channels (4000:E334 mov bp,[0x2]), snd_channel_vol_envelope/release (4000:E55C/E582 mov di,[0x4]). Sound entries 5000:0008+3*AX read by sound_play (4000:DDA5 mov al,[es:bx+0x8]; DDBF mov ax,[es:bx+0x9]) and sound_stop_id (4000:DDEB). 64 entries: the table ends where the wave table (header word 0) begins at 00C9, leaving 1 byte (500C8) outside; highest literal sound number in code is 3Dh. Runtime: 140 of 200 bytes read.

structures.name: waves
structures.evidence: Wave table at header word 5000:0000 = 00C9: snd_channel_pitch_volume (4000:E50E shl ax,4 / add ax,[0x0] / rep movsw x8 to wave RAM 0280h) copies wave [+40h]*16; sound_init (4000:DD78) copies waves 0-3. 20 waves: highest wave operand in the sequences is 19 and wave 19 ends exactly at the PCM table (header word 1 = 0209). Runtime: 272 of 320 bytes read.

structures.name: pcm_table
structures.evidence: PCM table at header word 5000:0002 = 0209: snd_track_output_channels (4000:E334-E357) reads [bp+3n] word/byte as start and [bp+3n+3]/[bp+3n+5] as end of sample n. Entries 1-8 = the voice samples in assets/structures/pcm.json, entry 9 = end of sample 8 (5F6CD); entry 0 unused (note 0 = key off). Ends at the volume-envelope table (header word 2 = 0227). Runtime: 18 of 30 bytes read.

structures.name: vol_envelopes
structures.evidence: Volume envelope table at header word 5000:0004 = 0227: snd_channel_vol_envelope (4000:E552-E573 mov di,[0x4] / mov ax,[ds:bp+di] / FBh-FFh control codes, E64D-E65F) and snd_channel_release (4000:E576-E589 reads the byte before envelope env+1). 56 pointers (first pointer = 0227+2*56), 55 envelopes (sequence venv operands 1-54), last pointer 03DC is only used for envelope 54's release byte. Byte 503DC itself is not included (never read). Runtime: 323 of 437 bytes read.

structures.name: pitch_envelopes
structures.evidence: Pitch envelope table at header word 5000:0006 = 03DD: snd_channel_pitch_volume (4000:E4B2-E4EC, control 80h at E662-E676) and the noise path of snd_track_output_channels (4000:E426-E462, E67D-E695). 20 pointers (first pointer 0405 = 03DD+2*20); sequence penv operands 1-13; slots 14-19 point at 0630 = end of the envelope data (start of the sequences). Runtime: 372 of 595 bytes read.

structures.name: sequences
structures.evidence: Sequence bytecode interpreted by sound_tick (4000:DE8D, fetch loop DF4A, dispatch tbl_DF5F / tbl_DF8A) and the snd_cmd_* handlers (4000:DFAA-E2CC). Entry points = the 64 sound-table pointers (snd_table); recursive descent from them over jump/call/loop targets reaches every byte except 5 unreferenced pieces (0AAD-0AB0, 0D89-0D92, 1072-1281, 14C7-1596, 3735-3757; see docs/formats/sound.md), which still decode as well-formed command streams; the linear decode is aligned with every reached instruction and ends exactly at the first PCM sample (53770). Runtime: 9038 of 12608 bytes read.

structures.name: story_picture_ptrs
structures.evidence: load_story_picture (4000:F159 mov ax,[es:bx] with ES=F000h = BPE source segment; F160 mov bp,[es:bx+DL*2] for DL = 1-1Bh) -> bpe_expand. Word 0 = segment F000h, words 1-27 = story_picture BPE streams; ends at the first stream (F0038). Runtime: 36 of 56 bytes read.
